ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, signatories and intermediaries before acceptance. Screening must cover the UN Security Council Consolidated List, U.S. OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU restrictive measures, UK OFSI consolidated list, Belize domestic designated persons lists, PEP databases including family and close associates, and adverse media checks. Enhanced due diligence is compulsory for PEPs, high-risk countries, cash-intensive customs transactions and unusual remittance patterns. Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation must be retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends. Suspicious transactions must be reported to the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Official IBC Registry / Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry; name search, clearance and reservation are filed by licensed registered agents through the registry's online system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed IBC name must be expressed in Latin-alphabet characters. A name in Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic or another script will not be registered unless accompanied by a certified transliteration into English; the Registrar may register the English transliteration and note the foreign script. The name must end with an accepted Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Société Anonyme or equivalent suffix and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered or reserved name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reservation may be extended for successive 30-day periods by filing a renewal before expiry and paying the registry tariff. If the Registrar refuses a name, the registered agent must file within 30 days of the written refusal a formal reconsideration request stating grounds, supported by a subscriber or board resolution and the prescribed fee. If reconsideration is refused, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the Minister of Finance within 30 days of the reconsideration decision. The Minister's decision remains subject to judicial review in the Supreme Court of Belize.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may supplement but cannot replace the statutory registered office. The IBC must maintain a physical registered office in Belize under the control of a licensed registered agent. For the customs brokerage licence, the Customs and Excise Department requires a physical trade address and accessible records; virtual-office-only arrangements will not satisfy commercial substance review.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high: approximately 35–45% annual probability of unannounced or short-notice inspection once the customs brokerage licence is in force, driven by FIU AML/CFT supervision and Customs valuation controls; inspections may also occur at the IBC registered office on reasonable notice under the IBC Act and applicable Cap. 270 regulations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize, as amended; incorporation authority conferred under Sections 7, 12, 16 and 18
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Companies Registry, Ministry of Justice, Belize City, Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Companies Registry, culminating in a Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; IBC may issue shares without par value or with nominal par value, and no escrow account is required for formation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriber of the Incorporation Instrument is hereby allotted one ordinary share at par value, the consideration for which shall be credited towards the paid-up capital of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office located at the office of the licensed registered agent in Belize City is adopted as the Company's statutory address and registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons are appointed directors and officers of the Company: [Name] as Director and President, [Name] as Secretary and Treasurer. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, engage the licensed customs broker services, and file all requisite corporate and regulatory returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Personality Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Belize City (online or in-person filing window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request on Form IBC/R-1, containing the proposed corporate name or its numbered alternative, along with the registered agent's certificate. Once the Registrar confirms that the name is not undesirable or identical to an existing entity, the name is reserved for a renewable period of 30 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application Form IBC/R-1
Registered agent consent letter
Identification documents of the incorporator
Certificate of due diligence for the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, propose a phonetic, numeric, or prefix/suffix variant and refile the same Form IBC/R-1; the Registrar's objection must be cured within 10 business days by submitting an amended name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Instrument and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Ministry of Justice, Belize City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and file the Memorandum and Articles of Association before the Registrar, together with the registered agent's business license and the government filing fee. The Registrar will issue a Certificate of Incorporation upon satisfactory compliance within the statutory period.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed in accordance with IBC Act Section 7)
Registered agent's license and consent
Registered office confirmation letter
Duly completed application for incorporation (Form IBC/RA-7)
Payment of US$100 official filing fee
Identity documents of the first subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar files an objection or requisites additional particulars, the registered agent or local counsel must supply the clarification within 14 days; thereafter the Certificate of Incorporation issues nunc pro tunc.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The Board of Directors of the IBC (internal corporate action)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene and hold the first board meeting, adopt corporate bylaws, ratify the share allotment, adopt the registered office and registered agent appointments, appoint officers, and authorize the opening of banking facilities. Record all decisions in the minutes.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Board resolution appointing directors and officers
Consent forms from each director and officer
Registered office address confirmation
Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer appointment is defective, the board may convene an Extraordinary Board Meeting and rescind the invalid appointment, then execute a corrected written consent immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Licensed Customs Brokerage Entity Filing and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Customs and Excise Department, Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the corporate licensing application to the Comptroller of Customs, including the IBC Certificate of Incorporation, corporate governance documents, and the business plan for customs brokerage. No trading activity may commence until the Customs Brokerage License is issued.
required_dossiers: Application for Customs Brokerage License
Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum of Association
First board resolution showing authorized brokerage business
Current tax receipt or tax exemption certificate
Proof of professional qualification or experience of the designated broker
Business plan and operational premises lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried by the Comptroller, the company must provide supplementary declarations and, if necessary, satisfy an interview for the designated customs broker; resubmission is allowed without penalty within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Belize Customs and Excise Department, Ministry of Finance and Economic Development
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Customs Brokerage License (Class A Customs Broker Operating Permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (office-based commercial brokerage with negligible environmental footprint)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No statutory industrial discharge; wastewater must comply with municipal sewer ordinances, and waste office paper/electronics must be disposed through licensed waste haulers in accordance with the Solid Waste Management Act Chapter 312.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Belize Fire Service; building occupancy clearance from the Belize City Council; workplace safety inspection under the Labour Act, Chapter 297 confirming lighting, sanitation, and emergency exits; no special structural load clearance required for an office-based brokerage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize (https://taxservice.gov.bz); customs brokerage licensing additionally regulated by the Belize Customs Department (https://customs.gov.bz) using the ASYCUDA World single-window platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders incorporate the IBC through a licensed registered agent under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), then submit the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum of Association, registered agent letter, and specimen signatures to the Tax Service Department on Form REG-1 to obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN). A customs brokerage IBC must also hold a Customs Broker Licence under s.22 of the Customs and Excise Duty Act, which requires a valid TIN, a licensed individual broker or qualified firm with a registered place of business in Belize, and professional indemnity cover. If annual taxable supplies in Belize exceed BZ$150,000, the IBC must additionally file Form GST-02 for Goods and Services Tax registration. A formal Tax Exemption Certificate may be issued to confirm the statutory exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, business tax, stamp duty, and dividend withholding. Domestic business with Belize residents is prohibited for IBCs absent ministerial consent under the IBC Act, and the tax exemption is preserved only where brokerage services are rendered to non-residents on offshore or transit cargo.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Belizean law. An IBC may voluntarily surrender tax-exempt status by converting to an ordinary Belize company pursuant to s.150 of the IBC Act and thereby become subject to chargeable income at entity level under the Income and Business Tax Act. Under the Economic Substance Act 2019, an IBC managed and controlled in Belize is deemed tax-resident for substance purposes and must file an annual economic substance notification; however, customs brokerage is not a designated relevant activity, so no substance test is triggered solely by this business line.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) – Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZ$150,000 annual value of taxable supplies (BZD fixed peg: BZ$2 = USD$1)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance, API connectivity, or digital stamping regime for GST. Registered customs brokers must issue serially numbered tax invoices showing the broker's TIN and GST registration number, file monthly GST returns via Form GST-1 through the Tax Service e-filing portal, and retain invoice and customs records for six years. Customs export and import declarations are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World customs clearance system, which operates separately from GST invoice controls.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the export of goods from Belize and to services supplied to a non-resident for direct use and benefit outside Belize, including services directly performed upon or in connection with exported goods and services comprising international transit freight and bonded warehouse management (GST Act, Schedule 2). A customs brokerage IBC may claim 0% GST on brokerage fees, transit documentation, and bonded-warehouse handling invoiced to foreign principals for export-bound cargo, provided the services are not tied to local Belizean import consumption, the non-resident status of the recipient is documented, and the statutory export declaration and shipping evidence are retained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World Single Administrative Document)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing export from Belize
Customs Broker Licence and client Power of Attorney
Inward Remittance Certificate or Central Bank foreign-exchange conversion docket
GST export schedule and zero-rating declaration (Form GST-EX)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Tax Service Department and Customs Department conduct joint risk-based audits of export zero-rating claims. Non-compliant claims trigger reassessment, a civil penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded, monthly interest at 1.5%, and retrospective clawback of input tax credits previously refunded. Knowing or fraudulent presentation of false export documentation is a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to BZ$50,000 and/or imprisonment of up to three years, and carries mandatory suspension or revocation of the customs broker licence under the Customs and Excise Duty Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), Belize City, being the central bank, currency board administrator, and exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act, Chapter 61 of the Laws of Belize, as applied and modified subsequent to the 2023 integration of International Business Companies into the Companies Act, Chapter 250.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Belize maintains a de facto currency peg with a fixed official exchange rate of BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00, administered through the CBB under the Exchange Control Act. Current account payments are ordinarily convertible upon production of commercial documentation; capital account payments, profit repatriation, shareholder loan repayments, and head-office management fees require CBB exchange control approval, an authorization-to-purchase foreign currency, or a valid general permission. The Cayman-style pre-2023 IBC exemption from exchange control remains substantially operable only where the entity is designated as an offshore or USD-denominated account holder at a CBB-authorized dealer and does not create a domestic BZD credit balance with residents for prolonged periods. For this customs brokerage house, we recommend a dual-account architecture: (i) an onshore BZD operational account calibrated exclusively to customs duties, excise taxes, ASYCUDA World settlements, and local overheads; and (ii) a USD-denominated treasury account for freight forwarding, foreign sub-agents, reinsurance, and cross-border disbursements. Practical profit remittance hurdles to non-resident shareholders are low for fully tax-exempt or grandfathered IBCs, subject to filing of the annual economic substance declaration, confirmation of the beneficial ownership register, and segregation of income sourced from Belize customs services. The principal convertibility constraint arises when the company collects brokerage fees from domestic importers in BZD, which the CBB may treat as a Belize-source resident credit requiring authorization before conversion to USD; that risk is mitigated by denominating fees in USD under the master brokerage agreements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The Exchange Control (General) Regulations require any person in Belize receiving foreign currency for exported services, such as customs brokerage fees from a foreign principal, to offer the proceeds to a CBB-authorized dealer in Belize dollars within the statutory period, generally not later than three months after shipment or, where the payment terms so provide, within one month after receipt. The mandatory conversion ratio is effectively 100% when the funds land in a domestic BZD-linked account; it may be reduced to 0% only where the CBB or the authorized dealer has approved a USD offshore account designation or a formal general permission for the IBC. The customs brokerage house must structure fee collections from foreign customs principals through the USD treasury account and file the applicable services export declaration, failing which the broker risks exchange control penalties and blocking of the payment rail. Exact percentage obligations and timelines should be reconfirmed with the CBB Exchange Control Department during the account authorization.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD) and Operational Account (BZD)
Operational Account (BZD) with ASYCUDA World / ACH duty payment module

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: National Bank of Belize Limited, Belize City
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (BZD) for customs tariff, excise, and bonded transit escrow disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility with material legal constraints. Belize has no domestic EMI or standalone payment institution licensing class, and the CBB does not register foreign fintech EMIs as authorized dealers. Offshore digital EMIs, including Wise Business, Revolut Business, Currencycloud, and Airwallex, are not permitted to clear Belize customs duties through ASYCUDA World, cannot issue Belize-relevant tax documents, and are generally unwilling to onboard a Belize IBC with nominee shareholders and a medium-risk customs brokerage activity. They may be used only as auxiliary, low-value settlement channels for non-Belize supplier payments, and never as the primary treasury spine. The recommended architecture is a Belize commercial bank at the core, with the EMI serving solely as a secondary 'vendor aggregation' card or virtual account limited to minor foreign subscriptions; even then, fund flows must be reconciled monthly and tagged in the accounting system to preserve a clean audit trail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 269, the CBB Guidelines, and the Financial Intelligence Unit directives require banks to conduct customer due diligence on every director, shareholder, and beneficial owner of an IBC. Fully remote opening is not available in Belize as a standard practice; the compliance mandate requires at least one natural-person director (or the licensed Belize resident agent on behalf of the corporate directors) to be interviewed by the bank's compliance officer, either physically at the Belize branch or via a scheduled secure video conference with the bank's designated officer. The corporate documents must be certified and physicalized: apostilled or legalized Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, certified register of directors, register of shareholders, UBO declaration, signed and notarized board resolutions, and a physical copy of the Customs Brokers Licence. A laminated original or notarized counterpart of the corporate authorization must be lodged with the bank before the account is activated. This mandate is triggered even where the ultimate beneficial owner is a non-resident; the bank will additionally require the licensed resident agent to attest its records of the UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IBC with privacy layers: corporate directors, nominee shareholders, bearer share warrants, or registered-office-only substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full certified corporate register, share register, and UBO declaration; deed of trust or declaration of trust if nominee shareholders are held for a beneficial owner; signed attestation and certified records from the licensed Belize resident agent; physical lease or employment contracts in Belize evidencing economic substance; certified Customs Brokers Licence; and a board resolution identifying the natural person(s) with treasury authority, supplemented by a bank reference from the beneficial owner's domestic bank

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medium-Risk Enhanced customs brokerage receiving third-party payments and disbursing duty and freight funds for multiple importer principals
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customs Brokers Licence issued by the Belize Customs Department under the Customs Brokers Regulations; client/principal due-diligence file for each counterparty incorporating commercial invoices, bills of lading, importer tax identification, and power of attorney; ASYCUDA World duty-payment receipts; an internal AML/CFT compliance manual and transaction monitoring policy; monthly dual-control reconciliation of duty escrow; and an independent accountant's attestation on the segregation of client money

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Request for a USD-denominated treasury account with high inbound/outbound volume without a CBB exchange-control approval or general permission
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written application to the Central Bank of Belize for a general permission or offshore-account designation; Master Customs Brokerage Services Agreement; 12-month cash-flow forecast with per-transaction purpose codes; UBO and source-of-funds declarations; corporate income tax registration or CBB tax-status documentation under the post-2023 regime; and the licensed resident agent's substance attestation confirming premises, staff, and independent management in Belize

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are executed by SWIFT wire transfer (MT103) from the shareholder's bank to the IBC's USD treasury account at the Belize commercial bank, with the beneficiary field identified by the company registration number, the payment reason using the CBB-recognized purpose code for 'direct investment / contributed capital', and the corporate resolution and share subscription documents attached to the bank's exchange-control verification. The credited funds are held in the approved USD offshore account designation; if the capital is to be converted into BZD for working capital, the bank will require the CBB authorization to purchase Belize dollars. For shareholder loan injections, the remittance must reference an executed loan agreement specifying the interest rate, maturity, and repayment schedule to avoid recharacterization as equity or unrepatriable funds. The bank will verify the inbound wire against the economic substance declaration, the Customs Brokers Licence, and the beneficial ownership register before releasing funds into the treasury pool; no cash withdrawal or onward transfer is permitted until the exchange-control records are completed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Customs duty, excise taxes, and port charges are settled through the ASYCUDA World e-payment module, which debits the BZD operational account at the Belize commercial bank by electronic funds transfer or ACH-equivalent debit, with an automated receipt serving as the customs entry release; oversized entries may be paid by wire to the designated Customs Department revenue account. Cross-border disbursements to foreign freight forwarders, marine insurers, sub-agents, and customs software suppliers are cleared via SWIFT MT103 wire transfers with purpose codes corresponding to 'payment for transportation and customs services' or 'freight agent disbursement'. For high-value bonded merchandise, a commercial documentary letter of credit is issued through the Belize commercial bank under SWIFT MT700 and amended under MT707, payable through a confirming North American or European bank, ensuring that title documents are released only against compliant presentation of bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, and customs entry certificates. The operative treasury protocol is a hard two-account segregation: the BZD account is limited to duties, taxes, local port fees, and statutory payments, requiring dual approver release, while the USD account handles all foreign-currency vendor settlements; the ACH rails are reserved for recurring US-based broker-client duty debits and are reconciled against ASYCUDA World entries to preserve the customs audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BZD currency forwards contracted with a CBB-authorized dealer on a commercial underlying (confirmed customs duty, freight, and bonded-transit obligations), subject to the fixed 2.00 peg with a negotiated premium or margin

Offshore non-deliverable USD/BZD forwards (NDFs) with North American counterparties, permitted solely as a hedge of confirmed receivables and payables, not as a speculative position, and booked at the foreign parent or treasury intermediary level to avoid a Belize-resident derivative exposure

EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and MXN/USD outright forwards and near-dated FX spots for non-USD sub-agent and ocean-freight settlements, executed through the Belize bank's correspondent or a licensed international bank subsidiary

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) under ISDA 2002 negotiated outside Belize to match foreign-currency shareholder loans and capex financing, documented at the offshore treasury holding level so that the Belize IBC does not become a Belize-resident swap counterparty

Natural hedging instruments comprising same-day USD/BZD netting, segregated USD treasury accounts, pre-funded BZD term deposits warehousing duty cash-flow peaks, and contractual currency-of-settlement clauses in master brokerage agreements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: IBC Annual Return confirming current registered office, registered agent, directors, members, issued capital, charges and beneficial ownership records.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Belize Companies Registry, Belize City, through the licensed Belize registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation; no uniform fiscal calendar date applies to Belize IBCs.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default renders the annual government fee delinquent; a 10% monthly late penalty accrues up to 50% of the unpaid fee, the company becomes subject to administrative strike-off after continued non-compliance, and director disqualification provisions may apply under the Belize Companies Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual IBC Government Renewal Fee paid to retain the IBC's separate legal existence and tax-exempt status.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies Registry, through the licensed registered agent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; renewal is effective only after the Registry receives cleared funds and the registered agent has submitted the annual return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a penalty equal to 10% per month or part thereof, capped at 50% of the unpaid fee; arrears beyond six months may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution without court order, with assets vesting in the Government of Belize subject to restoration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a standard Belize IBC. An independent audit becomes mandatory only if the IBC's articles or shareholders so resolve, if a lender or the Belize Customs Department requires audited financial accounts in support of a customs brokerage license, or if the IBC elects Belize tax residency and carries on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Act.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Belize or Belize GAAP for any voluntarily prepared accounts; IBCs are not required to file financial statements with the Registry and there is no public disclosure requirement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each annual return, the IBC must confirm the identity of all ultimate beneficial owners and any change in shareholding or control during the preceding twelve months. The registered agent must maintain the UBO register at the registered office and update it within 14 calendar days of any transfer, allotment, or change in beneficial ownership. The Registrar may inspect the registers and impose monetary penalties for inaccurate or out-of-date UBO records. The register is not publicly accessible.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members including all share transfers, allotments and redemption notices
Minute Book containing resolutions of members and directors

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required as a matter of Belize law; if triggered voluntarily or by a counterparty, a local certified audit ordinarily ranges from USD 4,000 to USD 8,500 depending on transaction volume and customs brokerage records.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for International Business Company (IBC) under the International Business Companies Act (IBC Act), inclusive of full exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, business tax, withholding tax and stamp duty for 50 years. If the entity conducts taxable domestic operations in Belize without IBC exemption, the Income and Business Tax Act (IBTA) headline corporate rate is 25% on chargeable income, plus a quarterly Business Tax (gross receipts tax) at 1.75% applicable to general services.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IBC statutory exemption (0% effective rate) under the IBC Act; no tax on dividends, interest, royalties, rents or capital gains; exemption from all exchange control and stamp duty; 50-year grandfathering period. Domestic Belize companies have no general tax holiday, but export-oriented services may claim the export allowance under s.15 IBTA, and customs brokerage licensing does not itself confer any tax concession.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return and Annual Licence Fee Declaration — Belize Companies Registry / International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) electronic registered-agent portal (no income tax return is required for a tax-exempt IBC)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual licence fee and return payable on the anniversary of incorporation; standard administrative deadline is before 1 September each year, with a 30-day grace period; returns must be filed by the licensed registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IBC registration number, registered name, date of incorporation and registered office address in Belize City/Belize District.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact IBC certificate data; non-resident beneficial owners are not disclosed in this public return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent name and address; incumbent corporate secretary details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Belize-licensed registered agent is mandatory; non-resident directors are permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, class of shares, and confirmation that no share transfers occurred in the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearers shares are prohibited; non-resident shareholders must be record-identified to the registered agent for AML/CFT purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IBC has not carried on business with Belize residents, has not held local real estate, and has engaged only in permitted offshore or licensed external activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A customs brokerage house operating at a Belize port must declare whether it holds a domestic licence; if the declaration is false, the IBC forfeits its tax exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of Economic Substance status, CRS/FATCA self-certification and payment of the annual IFSC licence fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident IBCs not tax resident in Belize should certify 'non-resident' status to avoid an ESR filing obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of 10% after 30 days, escalating penalties, administrative strike-off after 3 months of continued default, loss of limited liability protection, and a BZD 100 per month late fee on licence renewal; directors may be fined up to BZD 10,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form C – Corporate Income Tax Return (Return of Income), filed via the Belize Tax Service Department e-Tax portal (applicable only if the entity becomes a domestic taxable Belize resident company)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, the statutory deadline is 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross income derived from customs brokerage, freight forwarding, bonded transit management and ancillary services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities pay a 15% final withholding tax on Belize-source service income in lieu of filing Form C; a filing obligation arises only if the company is managed and controlled in Belize.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income specifically exempt under the IBTA, including qualifying export allowances and, for an IBC, all IBC Act-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IBC cannot claim Belize-source domestic brokerage income as exempt if a local licence was obtained; such income is taxable at 25%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, rent, utilities, customs surety bond premiums, professional fees, and depreciation computed under IBTA schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to related non-resident service providers are deductible only if arm's length and supported by contemporaneous documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 – Chargeable Income and Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deductions, multiplied by the 25% corporate rate; tax credits for quarterly Business Tax paid are reconciled.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies with a permanent establishment in Belize file on the same basis; otherwise a 15% final withholding is applied to gross service revenue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 10% of the tax due; late payment interest at 12% per annum; additional 10% surcharge for persistent default; criminal prosecution for wilful non-filing with fines up to BZD 10,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Tax Quarterly Return (Form BT-1), filed through the Belize Tax Service Department e-Tax portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the end of each calendar quarter (15 April, 15 July, 15 October, 15 January).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross brokerage commissions, clearance fees, storage and bonded transit charges received during the quarter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Gross receipts attributable to a Belize permanent establishment are taxable; offshore-to-offshore transactions are excluded for a non-resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Receipts explicitly exempt under the IBTA; an IBC may claim full exemption only for income falling within the IBC Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exemption claims require a valid tax exemption certificate; agents must withhold 15% from payments to non-resident subcontractors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts multiplied by the applicable Business Tax rate of 1.75% for general service businesses (customs brokerage).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the return covers a non-resident contractor, report the 15% withholding tax separately and remit to the Tax Service Department.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 10% late filing penalty on the tax due; additional 10% penalty for late payment; interest at 12% per annum; repeated default triggers a business closure order, revocation of the customs broker licence, and personal liability for directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Belize imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an IBC or by a domestic Belize company under the IBTA; dividend distributions from an IBC are statutorily exempt from all Belize taxes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Belize has no comprehensive OECD-model double tax treaties; the CARICOM double taxation agreement (COATS) applies to residents of signatory CARICOM states. Protocol: (1) obtain a Belize Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the Belize Tax Service Department, (2) submit the TRC and a completed treaty relief form to the payer before payment, (3) provide a certificate of residence from the counterparty revenue authority upon request, and (4) retain the documentation for 5 years. For IBC dividend flows, no treaty relief is required because the domestic rate is already 0%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rates: 0% withholding on interest paid to non-residents on bona fide debt; 15% final withholding on royalties, technical service fees and management fees paid to non-residents (IBTA). CARICOM treaty caps dividends, interest and royalties at 15% for residents of COATS states; no treaty protection exists for residents of most non-CARICOM jurisdictions, so the statutory rate applies. IBC outbound royalties and interest paid from an exempt IBC account bear 0% Belize withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BZD 0 — Belize has no codified transfer pricing Local File or Master File monetary thresholds; however, the IBTA contains general anti-avoidance powers (s.48) to revalue non-arm's length transactions, and taxpayers engaged in cross-border related-party transactions with a Belize permanent establishment must maintain contemporaneous pricing records for 5 years and on demand produce them to the Tax Service Department.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance (Companies and Limited Partnerships) Act 2019 requires any Belize tax-resident company carrying on a 'relevant activity' (banking, insurance, fund management, financing, leasing, headquarters, shipping, IP, distribution and service centre) to demonstrate substantial economic presence in Belize, including physical premises, full-time employees and core income-generating activities in Belize. A customs brokerage or bonded transit management business (ISIC 5229) is not automatically a listed relevant activity unless it operates as a distribution/service centre; nevertheless, an IBC incorporated in Belize must file an annual economic substance declaration, comply with CRS/FATCA reporting, and if tax resident in Belize for any reason, maintain substance commensurate with its activity to avoid shell-company classification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilful omission of gross brokerage receipts, false invoicing of customs clearance services, under-declaring bonded warehouse fees, or shifting profits to a related offshore intermediary without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: IBTA offences: fine up to BZD 10,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years; civil penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded; interest at 12% per annum from the due date; forfeiture of customs broker licence and bond.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers and the appointed corporate secretary are jointly and severally liable for unpaid Business Tax and PAYE/withholding taxes; the corporate veil is pierced for fraudulent trading, exposing personal assets, travel bans, and director disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: IBC Prohibited Local Business / Unlicensed Customs Brokerage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An IBC conducting customs brokerage, bonded transit or port agency services within Belize or with Belize residents without converting to a domestic company and without a valid licence under the Customs Brokers (Licensing) Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the IBC Act prohibition on local business: penalty up to BZD 10,000 and each offending transaction is void and unenforceable; unlicensed customs brokerage: fine up to BZD 1,000 and/or imprisonment up to 6 months, plus revocation of the customs surety bond and seizure of goods.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the beneficial owner are personally liable for penalties and third-party losses; the IBC's separate legal personality is disregarded as a sham, and directors face criminal prosecution, personal restitution, and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Zero employees in Belize, no physical office, no active customs broker licence, no local bank account, or the IBC is used solely as an invoicing conduit for freight payments without any real management or operational activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Act fines and annual declaration penalties up to BZD 20,000; CRS/FATCA penalties; administrative strike-off by the Registrar; the IBC loses limited liability and cannot enforce contracts after strike-off; foreign exchanges may de-risk and close accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are subject to AML-derived fines, asset freezing orders and travel bans; where the shell was used to disguise illicit trade flows, directors face personal civil restitution and up to 14 years' imprisonment under the Money Laundering (Prevention) Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering and Trade-Based AML Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting cash or third-party payments for customs duties, false customs declarations, under-/over-invoicing of imported goods, using the IBC as a pass-through for tax evasion in another jurisdiction, or omitting to file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) as a Designated Non-Financial Business or Profession (DNFBP).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering (Prevention) Act 1996 (as amended), on indictment: fine up to BZD 500,000 and/or imprisonment up to 14 years; confiscation of proceeds; mandatory revocation of the Customs Brokers licence and deregistration of the IBC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The nominated Compliance Officer/MLRO, directors and any person in effective control face identical criminal penalties, joint and several civil liability for laundered amounts, international extradition exposure, and prohibition from holding any financial-services or customs licence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the IBC annual return, failure to pay the annual licence fee, or failure to file quarterly Business Tax returns for two or more consecutive quarters.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late penalties, licence forfeiture, automatic administrative strike-off under the Companies Act; the struck-off IBC's property vests in the Registrar and its contracts become unenforceable; reopening requires court restoration with a BZD 200 fee plus all arrears.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors remain personally liable for all debts and taxes accrued after strike-off; the statutory limitation shield is lifted; individuals may be summonsed, subjected to a travel ban, and held in contempt for failing to produce corporate records to the Tax Service Department.
